entities.name: Vít Kopřiva
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vít Kopřiva is a Czech professional tennis player. He has a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 60 achieved on 16 March 2026 and a career-high doubles ranking of No. 261 achieved on 17 October 2022. He is the current No. 4 Czech singles player. Kopřiva has won six ATP Challenger singles and two doubles titles.
